# netactuate_nke_node_pools (Data Source)

Lists node pools in an NKE cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_nke_node_pools" "example" {
  cluster_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (Number) Parent cluster ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Cluster ID.
- `node_pools` (List of Object) Each pool exposes `node_pool_id`, `name`, `type` (API mode), `package_id`, `labels`, `taints`, `autoscaling`, `desired_nodes`, `total_worker_nodes` and `ready_worker_nodes`. Taints contain `key`, `value`, and `effect`. Autoscaling contains `enabled`, `minimum_nodes`, and `maximum_nodes`.
